title: A licensee may not re-dispense a previously dispensed medication unless law, regulation or Board policy permits
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(5), unless otherwise permitted by law, regulation, or Board policy, a licensee may not re-dispense any medication which has been previously dispensed.
exam_relevance: Tests the prohibition on re-dispensing a previously dispensed medication and the three sources of permission the paragraph names.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

exceptions: Re-dispensing otherwise permitted by law, regulation, or Board policy
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
